title: Coinz
subtitle: Digital loyalty rewards platform
description: A dual-platform loyalty rewards system with a consumer app for earning and redeeming rewards, and a merchant dashboard for creating campaigns, managing teams, and tracking reward distribution across outlets.
problem: Businesses in East Africa need modern loyalty systems that integrate with digital payment methods. Existing solutions are either too expensive, too complex, or not adapted to the mobile-first market where WhatsApp and SMS dominate customer communication.
role: Built both the consumer-facing rewards app (dev.coinzz.club) and the merchant management dashboard (merchant.dev.coinzz.club) with campaign creation, team access controls, multi-outlet support, and real-time reward tracking.
approach: Dual-platform architecture — a lightweight consumer app optimized for mobile, and a full-featured merchant dashboard with campaign analytics and team management. Role-based access control with outlet-level permissions. Real-time reward tracking with event-driven architecture. Production-quality SEO with schema.org structured data on the consumer side.
hardestDecision: Designing the reward economics to be sustainable for merchants while remaining attractive to consumers — finding the right balance between reward value, redemption frequency, and merchant ROI across different business sizes.
outcome: Live platforms at dev.coinzz.club and merchant.dev.coinzz.club with multi-outlet support, campaign management, and team access controls.
whatIdChange: Would add analytics dashboards showing reward ROI per merchant, implement A/B testing for campaign optimization, and build API integrations with major East African payment providers.
